import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int MAXE = 900000;

    static int n, t;
    static int S = 202, T = 203;
    static int rp, cp;
    static int in;

    static int[] levelArr = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] itArr = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] edgeTo = new int[MAXE];
    static int[] edgeNext = new int[MAXE];
    static int[] edgeCap = new int[MAXE];
    static int edgeCnt;

    static int[][] srcId = new int[21][21];
    static int[][] sinkId = new int[21][21];
    static int[][] mark = new int[21][21];
    static int[][] dist = new int[21][21];
    static char[][] grid = new char[21][21];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[21][21];

    static int[] dr = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dc = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static void addEdge(int f, int t, int c) {
        edgeTo[edgeCnt] = t;
        edgeCap[edgeCnt] = c;
        edgeNext[edgeCnt] = head[f];
        head[f] = edgeCnt++;
        // swap f and t
        int tmp = f; f = t; t = tmp;
        edgeTo[edgeCnt] = t;
        edgeCap[edgeCnt] = 0;
        edgeNext[edgeCnt] = head[f];
        head[f] = edgeCnt++;
    }

    static boolean bfs(int source, int sink) {
        Arrays.fill(levelArr, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        levelArr[source] = 0;
        q.add(source);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int e = head[v]; e != -1; e = edgeNext[e]) {
                if (edgeCap[e] > 0 && levelArr[edgeTo[e]] == -1) {
                    levelArr[edgeTo[e]] = levelArr[v] + 1;
                    q.add(edgeTo[e]);
                }
            }
        }
        return levelArr[sink] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int sink, int flow) {
        if (v == sink) return flow;
        for (int e = itArr[v]; e != -1; e = edgeNext[e]) {
            if (edgeCap[e] > 0 && levelArr[v] + 1 == levelArr[edgeTo[e]]) {
                int pushed = dfs(edgeTo[e], sink, Math.min(flow, edgeCap[e]));
                if (pushed != 0) {
                    edgeCap[e] -= pushed;
                    edgeCap[e ^ 1] += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxflow(int source, int sink) {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfs(source, sink)) {
            System.arraycopy(head, 0, itArr, 0, head.length);
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dfs(source, sink, 1 << 30);
                if (pushed == 0) break;
                ans += pushed;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static boolean valid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && r < n && c >= 0 && c < n;
    }

    static void searchEdges(int a, int b) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(mark[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], -1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Y') mark[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        q.add(new int[]{rp, cp});
        q.add(new int[]{a, b});
        dist[a][b] = 0;
        dist[rp][cp] = 0;
        mark[a][b] = 1;
        mark[rp][cp] = 2;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] now = q.poll();
            int r = now[0], c2 = now[1];
            if (mark[r][c2] == 1 && grid2[r][c2] > '0' && grid2[r][c2] <= '9')
                addEdge(srcId[a][b], sinkId[r][c2], 9);

            if (mark[r][c2] == 1 && dist[r][c2] == t) continue;

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nr = r + dr[k], nc = c2 + dc[k];
                if (valid(nr, nc) && mark[nr][nc] == 0) {
                    mark[nr][nc] = mark[r][c2];
                    dist[nr][nc] = dist[r][c2] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
                } else if (mark[r][c2] == 1 && valid(nr, nc) && mark[nr][nc] == 2 && dist[nr][nc] == dist[r][c2] + 1 && grid2[nr][nc] > '0' && grid2[nr][nc] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(srcId[a][b], sinkId[nr][nc], 9);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) return;
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        S = 202;
        T = 203;
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        edgeCnt = 0;
        in = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 21; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(srcId[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(sinkId[i], -1);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                grid[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(S, in, grid[i][j] - '0');
                    srcId[i][j] = in++;
                }
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    rp = i;
                    cp = j;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                grid2[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
                if (grid2[i][j] > '0' && grid2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(in, T, grid2[i][j] - '0');
                    sinkId[i][j] = in++;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9' && grid2[i][j] > '0' && grid2[i][j] <= '9')
                    addEdge(srcId[i][j], sinkId[i][j], 9);
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9')
                    searchEdges(i, j);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxflow(S, T));
        sc.close();
    }
}
